pose: A heavily weathered bronze bell-buoy floating in the sea. It features a large, swinging mechanical brass bell mounted inside a three-sided frame. A pair of flightless diving birds (Hesperornis) are clumsily perched on the outer flotation ring, preening their wet feathers.

environmental_details.ground: The sea surface consists of shimmering azure blue water with a smoky grey, high-albedo chalky sediment plume visible just beneath the surface.
environmental_details.atmosphere: Direct midday sunlight with high-key exposure creates bright, wet specular reflections on the bronze framework and feathers.
